title: Detection of FLAG ULK1 and Endogenous ATG13 Interaction
author: Yongjia Duan

steps.title: Prepare NP-40 lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Use NP-40 lysis buffer supplemented with protease and phosphatase inhibitors to collect cell lysates.

steps.title: Lyse cells and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Wash cells with cold PBS (1 mL per well), add 200 µL NP-40 lysis buffer containing 1 mL protease inhibitor cocktail and 1 mL phosphatase inhibitor cocktail to each well, incubate on ice for 30 min vortexing every 10 min, then centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 10 min at 4 °C and collect the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Wash cells with cold PBS (1 mL per well).
Add 200 µL NP-40 lysis buffer plus 1 mL protease inhibitor cocktail and 1 mL phosphatase inhibitor cocktail per well.
Incubate on ice for 30 min, vortexing every 10 min.
Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 10 min at 4 °C and collect supernatant.

steps.title: FLAG affinity pull‑down
steps.instruction: Transfer 0.6 mg of cleared lysate to a clean tube, add 30 µL anti‑FLAG M2 affinity beads, and incubate 4 h at 4 °C with end‑over‑end rotation at 25 rpm.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 0.6 mg of cell lysate to a clean tube.
Add 30 µL anti‑FLAG M2 affinity beads.
Incubate for 4 hours at 4 °C with end‑over‑end rotation (25 rpm).

steps.title: Wash FLAG beads
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1,000 g for 1 min to pellet beads, discard supernatant, and wash beads three times with 1 mL NP-40 lysis buffer each.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 1,000 g for 1 min to pellet beads.
Remove supernatant and wash beads three times with 1 mL NP-40 lysis buffer.

steps.title: Elute bound proteins
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 40 µL 2X LDS buffer containing 1 mM DTT and 1 µL β‑mercaptoethanol, then heat at 95 °C for 5 min to elute proteins.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 40 µL 2X LDS buffer, 1 mM DTT, and 1 µL β‑mercaptoethanol.
Heat at 95 °C for 5 min to elute proteins.

steps.title: Separate eluate from beads
steps.instruction: Pass the eluate through a Spin‑X® column to remove beads and collect the protein solution.
